description: The image of a computably enumerable set under a total recursive numerical function is computably enumerable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.enumerable_image {A : ℕ → Prop} {g : ℕ → ℕ} (hA : REPred A)
  (hg : Computable g) : REPred fun y => ∃ x, A x ∧ g x = y
